claim: Multi-Attach enabled volumes cannot be created as boot volumes, so you cannot boot an EC2 instance from one.
question: Can you boot an EC2 instance using a Multi-Attach enabled volume?

values.display: can't be created as boot volumes

evidence.quote: Multi-Attach enabled volumes can't be created as boot volumes.

note: The FAQ answers this question with the single word No (too short to quote); evidence taken from the user guide.

claim: An application can use Multi-Attach if it is built on Windows Server Failover Cluster, coordinates safe access to shared storage with NVMe reservations, or coordinates safe access at the application level.
question: Which applications can use EBS Multi-Attach?

values.display: coordinates safe access at the application-level

evidence.quote: Your application can use Multi-Attach if the application is built on Windows Server Failover Cluster, coordinates safe access to shared storage using NVMe reservations, or coordinates safe access at the application-level.
